details.reason: No third plausible, distinct prompt-only mutation with an effect the existing oracle can detect: unlisted requester ids always co-trigger the ownership rule, which is excluded, and over-long or injection-style ids have no distinct oracle-visible failure.

Remaining values (zero, negative, non-integer or very large amounts) have no plausible prompt edit with an effect the existing oracle can detect that is distinct from the other candidates; the refund tool takes no amount, so amount-format mutations cannot reach the amount rule.
Remaining values (approval for the wrong payment, state changed since approval) are not expressible in the static World or not detectable by the existing oracle.
Repeating the same payment in a request is detectable only through the duplicate-refund code, which is excluded, and bulk requests exceed the DSL limit of four payments.
Terse, verbose and multi-request phrasing have no plausible distinct mutation with an effect the existing oracle can detect; multi-request phrasing overlaps the multi-payment mutants.
